visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short brown hair, wearing a grey and black patterned hoodie and khaki Nike joggers, stands in an indoor batting cage featuring green artificial turf and purple corrugated walls. He holds a black SSR baseball bat vertically, pointing at his fingers and the handle to demonstrate initial grip basics. (2) He adjusts his posture and turns sideways, demonstrating a batting stance while holding the bat over his shoulder. He lifts his right elbow significantly, using his left hand to point at the 90-degree angle formed by his arm to emphasize the technical form. (3) The man returns to a front-facing position, continuously adjusting his hands on the bat's handle to show variations in finger alignment. In the background, a white rectangular board is mounted on the purple wall. (4) He concludes the demonstration by rotating the bat and showing the grip from multiple perspectives, finally waving a hand toward the lens with a smile to signal the end of the instructional segment.

(6) [Subtitle]: 所以推薦大家. (7) [Subtitle]: 你可以試著讓你的手指頭變成這個樣子. (8) [Subtitle]: 這樣子握棒可以讓你的右手手肘可以抬起來. (9) [Subtitle]: 右手手肘抬起來才可以有效的去製造出這一個框架. (10) [Subtitle]: 打擊框架也就是我們說的完美90度角. (11) [Subtitle]: 這個定律大家可以去參考中華職棒、美國職棒、日本職棒、韓國職棒. (12) [Subtitle]: 所有強打者他們的後手的手肘都是抬起來的. (13) [Subtitle]: 他們在準備打擊的時候他們後手的手肘一定都是抬起來的. (14) [Subtitle]: 尤其最明顯的大谷翔平. (15) [Subtitle]: 大谷翔平他的手肘已經抬高超過90度了. (16) [Subtitle]: 這個是大家可以去做參考的. (17) [Subtitle]: 最基礎的不管是這樣子拿還是這樣子拿還是這樣子拿都可以. (18) [Subtitle]: 最根本的問題就是你的手肘必須要抬高. (19) [Subtitle]: 像之前紅雀隊的強打Pujols他就是這樣子拿. (20) [Subtitle]: 但是他的手肘是有辦法抬高的. (21) [Subtitle]: 只要你的手肘有辦法抬高而不會不舒服的情況下就OK了. (22) [Subtitle]: 所以重點其實不是在這裡重點是在你的手肘有沒有辦法舒服的抬高. (23) [Subtitle]: 我就這樣子我的手就是這樣子. (24) [Subtitle]: 分享給你們.
